ramen_ca_032269276c4661356407.caveats: The linked brand menu currently defaults to the Mile-End location. ramen_ca_01c8949ce9e17eb6cb9a.caveats: The recorded menu prices come from the restaurant’s merchant listing on Uber Eats, not an in-person receipt. ramen_ca_127baa60edce046d4075.caveats: Dojo’s Vegetarian Ramen explicitly includes a farm egg, so the default bowl is not vegan. The Shoyu, Miso and Spicy bowls list pork broth and pork belly.
